StyleBase.description: The descriptive base type for both style guideline records, and recipe style provisions. Provides unique properties to identify individual styles

category.description: Name of the category the style belongs to in its style guide.

category_id.description: Identifier of the category the style belongs to in its style guide. This is a string because not every identifier is a number: BJCP uses 3 for Czech Lager, but M1 to M4 for meads and C1 and C2 for ciders.

category_number.description: Number of the category the style belongs to in its style guide, which cannot represent an identifier such as M1. Kept so existing documents stay valid. Write category_id instead; readers should accept either and prefer category_id when both are present.

style_letter.description: The upper case letter, or one or two digit number, identifying the style within its category, such as the B of BJCP style 3B. Omit it if the style has none.

style_guide.description: The style guide the style is defined by, such as BJCP 2021 or Brewers Association 2017.

type.description: The kind of beverage the style describes.

StyleType.description: StyleType provide information for Style categorization

original_gravity.description: The range of original gravity for the style.

final_gravity.description: The range of final gravity for the style.

international_bitterness_units.description: The range of bitterness for the style.

color.description: The range of colour for the style.

carbonation.description: The range of carbonation for the style.

alcohol_by_volume.description: The range of alcohol content by volume for the style.

notes.description: Free text notes about the style.

aroma.description: The aroma a beer in this style should present.

appearance.description: The appearance a beer in this style should present.

flavor.description: The flavour a beer in this style should present.

mouthfeel.description: The mouthfeel a beer in this style should present.

overall_impression.description: A summary of the overall character of the style.

ingredients.description: The ingredients characteristic of the style.

RecipeStyleType.description: RecipeStyleType defines style information stored in a recipe record

StyleCategories.description: The kind of beverage a style describes.
